SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'llm_call' AND status = 'success') as success_calls,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE action = 'llm_call' AND status = 'failure') as failed_calls,
  COALESCE(SUM(cost_usd), 0) as total_cost
FROM audit_log WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE;
